name: Greens Storage Austin
opened: Operated by CubeSmart (store 6992); the signage reads CubeSmart

buildings.name: Main Building
buildings.note: Five-story climate-controlled building, 200 ft 11 in x 155 ft 11 in overall (Merriman Anderson as-built set, sheets A1.01-A1.05). Lobby, elevators and office on the south (parking) side, stairs at the west and east ends; the drive aisle on the east side runs out to Parmer Ln. Every unit is traced from the floor plans: numbers start with the floor (1000-1146 on level 1 to 5000-5250 on level 5) and run in a serpentine along the corridors. The plans carry sizes but not numbers, so each unit's cell comes from matching the rent roll's size sequence to the plan; the direction along a row of identical units follows that serpentine.

sources: Parcel: Williamson County Appraisal District (WCAD R569024, Broadstone at Parmer Blk A Lot 2A, 2.818 ac, Greens Austin LLC, DBA CubeSmart)

Building and unit positions: Merriman Anderson architectural as-builts (Egnyte: Greens Austin, LLC > Properties > 8023 W Parmer Lane > Development > Plans & Maps > Construction Close Out Docs > 8. As Builts > Arch.pdf), floor plans A1.01-A1.05 - unit counts per floor (147 / 253 / 251 / 250 / 251) match the unit numbering exactly
Paved area: traced on the detail imagery along the drive, parking and fire-lane layout of the Merriman Anderson architectural site plan A0.01 (issued for construction 03/06/2018, in the Final Set)
Units: CubeSmart rent roll for store 6992, 08/31/2026 (966 rented units); vacant sizes read from the plan cell each vacant number falls in
Not in Cubby: the store runs on CubeSmart's system, so there is no live link
